answer_1.quote: We format questions as user messages and answers as assistant messages. We then estimate p θ ('yes') by summing the predicted probabilities over variants of the word 'yes', within the top 10 most likely tokens, and vice versa for 'no'.
answer_1.outputs: Binary answers ('yes' or 'no') to political and attitude questions

answer_2.quote: Treating the respondents' actual answers to the target questions as gold labels, we calculate an average personalization accuracy (PA), which tests whether the LLM can accurately model the respondents' answers based on their previous answers.
